mostWorthwhile.text: Making and using the water filter was most worthwhile: the description explained how its layers work and why clearer water still needs boiling.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and then covering the jar felt predictable, though both steps served the goal.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the hollow pipe to hold the filter layers; the explanation made its role clear.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the filter, storage and drain all had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the practical explanations of the filter and water safety made the familiar combinations more interesting.
